title: Battle of Pirajá
text: The Battle of Pirajá was fought as part of the Independence of Bahia and more broadly, as part of the Brazilian War of Independence. It was fought in Pirajá, now a neighborhood of the city of Salvador, Bahia on November 8, 1822. The Battle of Pirajá was the largest engagement in the fight for the independence of Bahia, involving approximately 10,000 troops.
